g.text: Release Marks (UC-03) and student access to released results
role, department and currency checks (as in Moderate Marks part 1)
[not releasable (not approved, stale, or before the effective deadline - proposed D1)]
Unreleased, unapproved or stale results are never returned to a student, and a
student cannot request another student's rows (BR-01, BR-06, FR-17).
